mapper.select: SELECT o.warehouse_id, o.purchaser_id, oi.sku_id, oi.spu_code_snapshot AS spu_code, oi.product_name_snapshot AS product_name, oi.sku_code_snapshot AS sku_code, oi.sku_name_snapshot AS sku_name, oi.purchase_unit_snapshot AS purchase_unit, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count, SUM(oi.planned_quantity) AS planned_quantity, SUM(oi.line_amount) AS order_amount FROM purchase_order o JOIN purchase_order_item oi ON oi.purchase_order_id = o.id AND oi.deleted = FALSE WHERE o.deleted = FALSE AND o.submitted_at >= #{startAt} AND o.submitted_at < #{endAt} AND o.status IN #{status} GROUP BY o.warehouse_id, o.purchaser_id, oi.sku_id, oi.spu_code_snapshot, oi.product_name_snapshot, oi.sku_code_snapshot, oi.sku_name_snapshot, oi.purchase_unit_snapshot
